basics.description: Deploys the Site24x7 Azure Diagnostic Logs collector: a Function App that finds your resources, sets up their diagnostic settings and sends the logs to Site24x7 AppLogs.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Region for the collector's Function App and storage. Only regions that offer the Azure Functions Flex Consumption plan are listed. The collector collects from resources in every region.

basics.name: site24x7DeviceKey
basics.toolTip: In Site24x7: Admin > Developer > Device Key.

constraints.validationMessage: Paste the Device Key from Site24x7.

basics.name: site24x7Domain
basics.label: Site24x7 data center
basics.toolTip: The data center of your Site24x7 account, as in the address you sign in at.

basics.name: generalLogTypeEnabled
basics.label: Collect categories without a log type
basics.toolTip: Send logs from categories that have no Site24x7 log type to a general log type. You can change this later in Site24x7.

basics.name: resourceGroupName
basics.label: Resource group name (optional)
basics.toolTip: Leave empty to use s247-diag-logs-SUFFIX-rg, where SUFFIX is the deployment suffix (s247-diag-logs-rg without a suffix). To update an existing collector, enter the resource group it uses.

constraints.validationMessage: Up to 90 letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, periods and parentheses.

basics.name: deploymentSuffix
basics.label: Deployment suffix (optional)
basics.toolTip: Added to the names of the collector's resources, so that more than one collector can run in a subscription. Use letters and digits; other characters and spaces are removed.

options.text: Optional. Leave filters empty to collect logs from all supported resources in the subscriptions included below. Collection starts automatically after deployment.
Every active subscription where you can grant access is included. The subscription chosen on Basics hosts the collector and is always included.

elements.name: excludeSubscriptions
elements.label: Subscriptions to exclude
elements.toolTip: Leave empty to include every verified subscription. The subscription chosen on Basics hosts the collector and is always included. The collector receives Reader and Monitoring Contributor access in each included subscription.
